achievements.name: Serious Beginner
achievements.description: Complete any level in single player.

achievements.name: Serious Sam
achievements.description: Complete the single player campaign.

achievements.name: Are You Serious!?
achievements.description: Complete the game in single player on unmodified serious difficulty.

achievements.name: Serious Run
achievements.description: Complete the game in single player in half the estimated time on each level.

achievements.name: Ophthalmologist
achievements.description: Remove 10 Gnaar eyes.

achievements.name: Cardiac Surgeon
achievements.description: Rip out 10 Rocketeer hearts.

achievements.name: Chiropractor
achievements.description: Break 10 Soldier necks.

achievements.name: Kleer Wrestler
achievements.description: Tear off 10 Kleer heads.

achievements.name: Bug Hunt
achievements.description: Squash 10 Hatchling spiders.

achievements.name: Arachnophobia
achievements.description: Rip 10 Juvenile spiders apart.

achievements.name: Scorpion Slayer
achievements.description: Break 5 Arachnoid necks.

achievements.name: Load of Scrap
achievements.description: Rip Scrapjack's head off.

achievements.name: Trick Shot
achievements.description: Kill the kicked enemy while it is still in the air.

achievements.name: Useful Trophy
achievements.description: Kill an enemy with a gib torn from another enemy.

achievements.name: Berserker
achievements.description: Kill 3 enemies in one sprint with the Sledgehammer.

achievements.name: Old School
achievements.description: Complete the game in single player without manually reloading, aiming or sprinting.

achievements.description: Perform all possible finishing moves in the game.

achievements.name: Apprentice Egyptologist
achievements.description: Decipher an Egyptian text.

achievements.description: Decipher all Egyptian texts.

achievements.description: Rescue professor Stein. So to say.

achievements.name: Get the hell off my ride!
achievements.description: Secure the bird.

achievements.description: In the level 'Under the Iron Cloud', bring down the giant alien dropship by destroying the blue orbs on its underside.

achievements.name: Problem solver
achievements.description: Solve the riddle of the Sphynx.

achievements.name: Painful Divorce
achievements.description: Kill a Witch-Bride of Achriman.

achievements.name: Mission completed
achievements.description: Power up the Timelock.

achievements.name: Detroit Steel
achievements.description: At the end of the eleventh level, 'The Last Man on Earth', start the car.

achievements.name: The doorman should wear a suit

achievements.name: Rodeo Surfer
achievements.description: Use the Mutilator to surf after a Werebull.

achievements.name: Skewer
achievements.description: Pierce 5 enemies with one Devastator round.

achievements.name: Up Close and Personal
achievements.description: Gib 20 enemies from close range with a shotgun.

achievements.name: Killer Jewelry
achievements.description: Kill an enemy using the Mutilator.

achievements.name: Headsman
achievements.description: Decapitate a Khnum.

achievements.name: Bone Crusher
achievements.description: Smash 20 Kleers with the Sledgehammer.

achievements.name: Circle of death
achievements.description: Kill at least 3 enemies in one spinning Sledgehammer attack.

achievements.name: Clay Pigeons
achievements.description: Kill 5 Cave Demons while they're in air.

achievements.name: Maintenance time
achievements.description: Blow a Major Biomechanoid into pieces.

achievements.name: Look, it's a secret
achievements.description: Find at least 50 secrets in single player.

achievements.name: Top Secret
achievements.description: Find all secrets in single player.

achievements.name: Classic Outfit
achievements.description: Find Sam's classic outfit

achievements.description: Complete The Guardian of Time in single player on serious difficulty without dying or loading.

achievements.name: Vista
achievements.description: Find the Vista secret.

achievements.name: Co-op Beginner
achievements.description: Complete any level in cooperative with at least 2 players.

achievements.name: Co-op Master
achievements.description: Complete the campaign in cooperative with at least 2 players.

achievements.name: Coin-op Co-op
achievements.description: Complete a Coin-op cooperative game on normal or higher difficulty.

achievements.name: Life Saver
achievements.description: Pick up at least 10 extra life items.

achievements.name: Gold Rush
achievements.description: Pick up 100 gold coins.

achievements.name: Deathmatch Beginner
achievements.description: Complete a deathmatch game with at least 1 frag.

achievements.name: Deathmatch Master
achievements.description: Win 10 deathmatch games.

achievements.name: Look Ma, I won!
achievements.description: Win a versus match.

achievements.name: Hammer Time
achievements.description: Frag 20 players with the Sledgehammer.

achievements.name: Beast Hunter
achievements.description: Complete a Beast Hunt match

achievements.name: Flag Thief

achievements.description: Win one My Burden match with at least 3 players.

achievements.name: Survivor
achievements.description: Earn a medal in Survival.

achievements.name: Golden Survivor
achievements.description: Earn a gold medal in Survival.

achievements.name: Christmas In Cairo
achievements.description: During the in-game Christmas event (December 10 to January 5), decorate the Christmas tree.

achievements.name: Jewel of the Nile
achievements.description: Complete the Jewel of The Nile single player campaign.

achievements.name: Reindeer Hunter
achievements.description: During the Christmas event, decorate the Christmas tree on every level to unlock the Rodolfo player model.
